meta.title: CET Vocabulary
meta.description: Floating flashcards for CET-4/6 words: three-key grading (know/fuzzy/unknown) with Ebbinghaus spaced review. 5805 words from ECDICT (MIT). Open it any time.

title: Vocabulary
voiceSysNone: No English voice pack detected — pronunciation now uses online human recordings (US/UK, needs network). For offline use, an administrator can add English voices in Windows Settings → Time & language → Speech.
voiceSysOk: {n} system English voice(s) found; online recordings are preferred and system voices serve as the offline fallback.
resetConfirm: Click again to erase progress for {n} words (valid 3.5s)
resizeHint: Drag to resize · double-click to reset
emptyQueueHint: Reviews and new words are done for today
quizStay: Wrong answers stay put — press → to continue
settingsAutoOpen: Pop up while the model thinks
autoOpenToast: Model is thinking — quick vocab break 📖
scNote: Single keys (Space, digits) work only while the window is expanded and the caret is not in a text field; Alt combos work anywhere on the page.
practiceNoExtra: No more new words to practise
readEmpty: No learned words yet — learn a few first
readExampleHint: Some words have no examples yet — skipped automatically
cutHint: I know this: move to low-frequency maintenance, checked later
cutFlash: ⚔ Cut — moved to low-frequency maintenance (a miss sends it back)
cutListHint: These are out of the daily queue and return for a long-interval check; a miss sends one back to stage 1, or recall it any time.
cutDaysHint: Cut words are checked every N days; a failed check sends the word back to stage 1.
maintHint: A cut word returns for one long-interval check; a miss sends it back to stage 1
starHint: Opens the project page — click Star there (a browser plugin cannot authorise on your behalf)
resetHint: Resetting erases all learning progress (memory stages, review schedule, cut list) and cannot be undone. The word book and settings stay.
